The '''Essebra system''' was a [[Binary star system/Legends|binary star]] [[Star system/Legends|system]]<ref name="XWvTF:BoP" /> located within the [[Airam sector/Legends|Airam sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> A space battle between the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] took place near [[Essebra]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="XWvTF:BoP" />
